title: Past simple: what happened
point: Use the past simple for finished actions at a specific time in the past, and watch the irregular verbs.

sentences.ja: 昨日の夜、友達と焼肉を食べに行った。
sentences.text: I went out for Korean barbecue with friends last night.
sentences.note: "Go out for" + food is how people say they went out to eat something.

sentences.ja: 財布を家に忘れてきちゃった。
sentences.text: I left my wallet at home.
sentences.note: When you say where, use "leave"; "forget" alone means it slipped your mind.

sentences.ja: 先週、成績のことで教授にメールした。
sentences.text: I emailed my professor about my grade last week.
How did you like the movie?

sentences.ja: 彼は会議に間に合わなかった。
sentences.text: He didn't make it to the meeting on time.
sentences.note: "Make it" is the everyday way to say 間に合う.

sentences.ja: 私たちは三年前に大阪に引っ越しました。
sentences.text: We moved to Osaka three years ago.

sentences.ja: 昨日はほとんど寝られなかった。
見積もりはお客さんに送った？
sentences.text: Did you send the quote to the client?

sentences.ja: 駅で偶然高校の同級生に会った。
sentences.text: I ran into a high school classmate at the station.
sentences.note: "Run into" means meeting by chance; "meet" sounds planned.

sentences.ja: そのパソコン、いくらだった？
sentences.text: How much did you pay for that laptop?
